lines: 逆仙成魔传最新章节_第十六章 胆小鼠辈第1页_逆仙成魔传废个球_热点小说网
> 第十六章 胆小鼠辈（第1页）
只见那束升大阵所散发出了金黄的气焰，那气焰的气势丝毫不弱于二郎神的那个椅子。
随着一众神仙使用全力催动大阵，那金黄气焰已经完完全全脱离了原本的形态。
那气焰突然光芒万丈，就如同一条金龙在上方盘旋着。
只见太白金星眉头紧皱，单手捏诀，朝着那天宫道的方向一指，那金龙龙吼阵阵向天宫道飞冲了过去。
此时在天宫道内的人以及正在飞升的人们也都纷纷注意到了那霸气无比的金龙。
那些人见到这金龙有如此气势竟都停下了脚步，开始观察起这金龙，毕竟他们一个个的都是从凡间飞升过来的见到这般阵仗属实惊叹。
忽然在前面的一个人，竟打了一个冷颤，开始掉头往回跑。
这人边跑还边喊道“快跑!这……这这金龙好像是朝咱们来的!”
在他周围的人见到他这般模样先是一愣，又仔细打量了那个金龙，顿时脸色大变，也都和那人一样转身就跑。
一开始逃跑的人都是听见了率先逃跑的人所说的话才开始逃跑的，可其他人距离太远不明所以见他们这般慌张，也都纷纷往回跑。
没一会，加入他们一起逃跑的人越来越多，可大多数的人脸上依旧是满脸的茫然与不解，但他们的直觉告诉他们跑就完了!
只是他们实力实在是有限，速度太慢，金龙转眼间就要到达他们跟前，并以极快的速度朝他们冲击过来。
那些不明所以就跟着跑的人一瞬间就明白了所有不解，个个祭出了各自的逃命手段，拼了老命的逃跑。
整个天宫道以及正在飞升的人们竟乱作一团，争先恐后的往来时的方向跑去。
可一切都是徒劳，因为，那个金龙真的是太快了，距离他们仅仅只差一步之遥。
面对这般强大的存在，无数人面如死灰，有些人已经停止逃跑，更有些人已经瘫坐在地放声大哭，等待着死神的降临。
不是他们不想跑，而是他们根本没有办法，不管怎么做仿佛一切都是无用功，他们更想不明白他们历尽千辛万苦从一个曲曲凡人修炼成仙，到头来却是竹篮打水一场空，他们不甘缺又无力。
只见那条金龙已经接触到那群人们了，只不过金龙不没有像他们想象的那样将他们杀害。
竟只是将这天宫道以及正在飞升的人们给包裹束缚起来，貌似并没有给他们造成什么实质上的伤害。
但依旧有些人的脚下出现了一些淡黄色不明液体。
令人尴尬的是，那些脚下出现液体的人们虽然没有死，但也都被那金龙束缚住了，这就意味着他们没有办法去清理。
一时间无数目光都纷纷汇聚在了那些出现液体的人身上，那目光有的是同情，但嘲笑戏谑的目光却是更多。
虽然周围的人嘴也被束缚了无法说话，但有的时候目光也是可以杀人的。
此时那些出现液体的人真是生不如死，一个个脸红耳赤，想找个地洞一头钻进去，可是他们仍旧被束缚着。
此时南天门外，一名气质超然的中年男子正负手而立观察着下方天宫道众人，没错!此人正是二郎神。
很显然，就连一向严肃冷漠的二郎神，都被刚才发生的事给逗乐了。
再看看其他神仙，除了太白金星，一个个脸色涨红，身体颤抖，当然他们不是害羞导致这样的，他们是憋笑憋成这样的。
在场那么多有头有脸的神仙，更何况还有二郎真君在此，他们这些小神仙谁敢随意的笑出声来。
忽然有一个神仙实在忍不住笑了出声又连忙捂住了嘴巴，看看周围没人注意到他，便放心下来。
“呵呵呵!太白老头，看看，费这般周折，却弄上来什么货色？这些人就是你所说的天才吗”
二郎神笑着看向了太白金星，可以看出二郎神此时心情很是不错。
但太白金星却从一开始就阴沉着脸，一声不吭。
在他周围的神仙见气压不对，也都纷纷四散开来，生怕太白金星发火迁怒于他们。

> Chapter 16 The Cowardly Young Man (Page 1)
I saw the golden arrogance emitting from the Shengda Formation, and the momentum of that arrogance was not weaker than that of Erlang Shen's chair.
As the gods used all their strength to activate the formation, the golden flames had completely separated from their original form.
The arrogance suddenly shone brightly, like a golden dragon hovering above.
I saw Taibai Jinxing frowning, making a secret with one hand, pointing in the direction of the palace road, and the golden dragon roared towards the palace road.
At this time, the people in Tiangong Road and those who were ascending also noticed the extremely domineering golden dragon.
Those people stopped when they saw the golden dragon with such momentum and began to observe the golden dragon. After all, they had all ascended from the mortal world and were really amazed to see such a formation.
Suddenly, a person in front shuddered and started to turn around and run back.
As he ran, the man shouted, "Run! This... this golden dragon seems to be coming towards us!"
The people around him were stunned for a moment when they saw him like this, and then looked at the golden dragon carefully. Their expressions suddenly changed, and they all turned around and ran away like that person.
The people who ran away at the beginning all started to run away after hearing what the person who ran away first said, but the others were too far away to know, so when they saw how panicked they were, they all ran back.
After a while, more and more people joined them in escaping, but most people's faces were still full of confusion and confusion, but their instincts told them to just run away!
It's just that their strength is really limited and their speed is too slow. The golden dragon will reach them in the blink of an eye and charge towards them at extremely fast speeds.
Those who followed him without knowing why suddenly understood all their confusions, and each of them used their own escape methods and tried their best to escape.
The entire Tiangong Road and the people who were ascending were in a mess, scrambling to run in the same direction.
But everything was in vain, because the golden dragon was really too fast, only one step away from them.
Facing such a powerful existence, countless people's faces were ashen, some people had stopped running away, and some people had collapsed on the ground and cried loudly, waiting for the arrival of death.
It's not that they don't want to run, it's that they have no choice at all. No matter what they do, everything seems to be in vain. They can't understand that they have gone through all the hardships to cultivate from a mortal to an immortal, but in the end they are in vain. They are unwilling and powerless.
I saw that the golden dragon had come into contact with that group of people, but it didn't kill them as they imagined.
It actually just wrapped up the Tiangong Dao and the people who were ascending, and it didn't seem to cause any real harm to them.
But some light yellow unknown liquid still appeared under the feet of some people.
What's embarrassing is that although those people who had liquid under their feet were not dead, they were restrained by the golden dragon, which meant that they had no way to clean it up.
For a time, countless eyes were focused on those who had liquid. Some of the eyes were sympathetic, but there were more eyes that were ridiculing and joking.
Although the mouths of the people around him are also bound and unable to speak, sometimes their gazes can kill.
At this time, those people with liquid appearing were really worse than death. They were all red-faced and wanted to find a hole in the ground to crawl in, but they were still restrained.
At this time, outside the Nantian Gate, a middle-aged man with an aloof temperament was standing with his hands behind his back, observing the people in Tiangong Dao below. That's right! This man is none other than Erlang Shen.
Obviously, even Erlangshen, who was always serious and indifferent, was amused by what just happened.
Looking at the other gods, except for Taibai Jinxing, all of them had red faces and trembling bodies. Of course, they were not like this because of shyness, they were like this because they were suppressing laughter.
There are so many respectable gods present, not to mention the fact that Lord Erlang is here, who among these little gods dares to laugh out loud casually.
Suddenly, one of the gods couldn't help laughing and quickly covered his mouth. Seeing that no one around him noticed him, he felt relieved.
"Hahaha! Old man Taibai, look what you got out of all this trouble? Are these people what you call geniuses?"
Erlang Shen looked at Taibai Jinxing with a smile, and it could be seen that Erlang Shen was in a very good mood at this time.
But Taibai Jinxing had a gloomy face from the beginning and remained silent.
When the gods around him saw that the air pressure was not right, they all dispersed, fearing that Taibai Jinxing would get angry at them.
